thread:
Alex: Morning check-in — did the US-W prewarm test. We got 18/20 GPUs ready, 2 stuck in PENDING with the cloud API.
Maria: Seen that — looks like quota throttling in us-west1 on our project. I'm opening a support ticket.
Chet: FYI had a similar PENDING yesterday; the nodes were pending because the spot pool scaled too slowly.
Maria: Ticket #INC-3421 opened with CSP. They requested the resource ID and recent API call logs.
Alex: Pasted logs below:
```
2026-03-17T08:12:01Z provisioner: requestQuota -> 40GPUs
2026-03-17T08:12:03Z cloudAPI: quota_approval_pending
2026-03-17T08:12:10Z provisioner: pool-create -> pool-2 (spot)
```
Jamie: For now, can we fallback to on-demand for the missing 2 GPUs? That'll cost a bit but keeps the canary warm.
Alex: I can patch the autoscale policy to allow 10% on-demand fallback. PR 4207 created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4207
Chet: Reviewing PR 4207 now — small nit in the rollout script, but LGTM otherwise :thumbsup:
Maria: CSP replied — said quota is being applied but there are existing pending operations blocking. They're clearing it, ETA ~30m.
ProvisionBot: [bot] Prewarm completed for pool-1 (24 GPUs) in eu-west1 :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: Heads-up, ap-southeast1 has 95% GPU quota utilization across dedicated pools. Recommend throttling non-critical jobs.
Alex: Noted. I'm disabling nightly loadtests in ap-southeast1 for tonight. Patch queued in deploys: #deploy-ops-773
Jamie: Can we add an alert for quota > 90% per region? Currently only overall usage alerts exist.
Maria: Filed infra-ops ticket INFRA-998 for per-region quota alerting + runbook.
Chet: Quick check — anyone seen unexpected evictions in us-east1 earlier? I saw 3 evictions tied to maintenance events.
Alex: Yep, two were maintenance-driven, one was spot eviction. We retried and the jobs completed.
Maria: Blocker for me: need the cloud account owner to approve a temporary quota bump for us-west1. Pinged legal/finance for approval.
Jamie: Today I'll finish the per-region dashboard and follow up on the eviction metrics. Also pinging cloud support if INC-3421 stalls.
Alex: I'll monitor the prewarm and flip the fallback if CSP doesn't clear. Thanks everyone.
Chet: Quick reminder — leave a short note in the capacity spreadsheet when you reserve headroom (column G).
Maria: Done — added 20 GPU headroom for the canary in us-west1.
ProvisionBot: [bot] Spot eviction window scheduled: 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z - 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z. Expect higher evictions in ap-southeast1.
ops-oncall: If evictions spike, route traffic to eu-west1 per the fallback policy.
Jamie: acked, will update runbook snippet.
Alex: Thanks team — let's regroup in the standup thread tomorrow if anything changes. :coffee:
